name: service_auto_assumed_must_be_named
description: Single-service company, customer asks to book without naming a service — the bot must name the assumed service in its own reply (not just silently assume it), since that's the only thing that survives to the next turn.

name: informal_time_after_date_no_reset
description: Regression test for a real WhatsApp bug: after the customer picks a date, replying with an informal time like '15h' (not an exact HH:MM button tap) must NOT reset the conversation back to asking which service or which date.

turns.message: 15h. Meu nome é Bruno Lima, telefone 11998887777.

successCriteria: The assistant retained the service (Corte de Cabelo) and the date (tomorrow) established in earlier turns, correctly interpreted '15h' as 15:00, and booked it — at no point re-asking which service or which date the customer wants, and never inventing a service name that was never registered.

name: no_contact_info_before_date_and_time
description: Regression test for a real WhatsApp bug: a terse, generic confirmation ('Sim') on a single-service company with no date or time established yet must NOT jump straight to asking for name/phone — that's only appropriate once a specific date AND time are already settled.
